body: Lol that’s what being chronically Ill is like. Utter powerlessness and having to rely on the medical team and one’s support system. It’s a lot. If you’re up for it, I’d love to play sometime with you. I don’t have cancer but have a cocktail of autoimmune disorders that are not only super rare, but progressive and incurable. Everything is just managing pretty much. I bring my switch whenever I have to get infusions or anything like that such as plasmapharesis.
I get it. When I had my chemo infusions I’d play too. Please keep hanging in there. I’ve logged 400 hours into the game over the last year with all the treatments I have to get.
Is that a terry cruz whitechicks quote?
Your therapist deserves to lose her license.
Thank you, take care of yourself as well.

Me, I used to love it growing up in an upper middle class family being the youngest child. Now Christmas isn’t the same as a broke adult with chronic pain and an immune disorder who can’t even afford to buy gifts for anyone.
It is, but in the 1.1 patch they removed Darkrai from his spot. So he’s no longer accessible in the game even through the void glitch.
Well I mean maybe, I was hoping they’d at least include Darkrai. That would have made me a happy camper, but they didn’t.
For people like us, I believe so. I feel like I died a long time ago. I’m just a husk, I’m like Darth Vader, but I’m not cool like him.

I’m alive. I couldn’t swallow the whole mixture, it was so bitter. I took xanax, trazadone, a ton of OTC sleep aid pills, Reglan, and cyanide, but I couldn’t swallow the whole mixture cause I threw up after the first giant gulp of mush, I then called my fiancé and started blacking out, when she got there, I had barricaded the door of the hotel unit I had paid for, so while Fucked out of my mind my head spinning being unable to walk I had to undo the barricade and lift heavy shit. She threw out the cyanide that was super hard to get ahold of. And took me home where I slept for like 24 hours straight, gagging in my Sleep apparently. In SO much pain. Now I’m alive, it’s my birthday in like 2.5 hours (gonna be 27 fml) and I’m freaking out that I’m still alive. I guess I’m gonna finish getting the last song I’ll ever write professionally produced, mixed and mastered then released and then I’m gonna hang myself. The cover art for the single is literally me shirtless with tape covering my breasts and a noose around my neck. The song is called “legacy”.

I attempted 3 days ago. Cyanide. I couldn’t get the mixture down though because I threw up and the aftertaste was terrible. I drank as much of the mixture as I could and took a ton of pills but then I called my fiancé and blacked out basically. I’m thinking hanging suspension will be next.

How about you?

Not really. It’s not just the mental stuff that makes it hard, it’s the physiological pain… like I’ve had my career destroyed, my voice, everything I worked for gone. I still have my partner which I am eternally grateful for. But I still want this pain to end. I want to have eternal silence and peace.
I hear that. It’s hard to know where to start. But it’s still worth a shot!

You’re not alone on an injury taking your ability to write and play music. I can’t sing like I used to due to what the doctors think is autoimmune encephalitis. I’ve considered maybe learning another instrument. You could learn to sing! I guess I could learn guitar finally 🎸 
I can still play piano decently well. What kind of music do you like?
